subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Does `openclaw/openclaw-secops` approve replacing the existing `openai/codex-action` pin with `52fe01ec70a42f454c9d2ebd47598f9fd6893d56` in workflows that pass OpenAI API-key secrets?
rationale: This is a trust decision about third-party action code executing with repository secrets; the dependency update itself cannot establish that approval.

options.title: Audit and prove the credentialed update
options.body: Review the exact Codex action revision and attach redacted successful output from the affected trusted workflows before merging.

options.title: Keep the current Codex action pin
options.body: Split or defer the Codex action update while allowing a separately reviewed action-refresh path for lower-risk workflow actions.

recommendation.title: Audit and prove the credentialed update
recommendation.body: Review the exact Codex action revision and attach redacted successful output from the affected trusted workflows before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly routes multiple touched security and dependency workflow surfaces to this team.
